name: Splintered Hull

description.content: Increases the frequency of [Blood Orbs] dropped by Survivors by [33%].
Survivors drop an additional [Blood Orb] whenever they vault, throw down a Pallet, exit a Locker, crouch, or fail a Skill Check.

quote: "To plan subterfuge, begin with a counsel of none." -Renjiro's Doctrine 7:9
